And POL-NS-03 forbids any assertion that a coordinate is a particular venue, block or entrance except on a venue_id or on a party statement in the chat log; the driver's claim that 'the pin in my app showed the carpark side' rests on no venue_id comparison and no chat statement, so it establishes nothing.

ruling.explanation: Rider, the $4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. Driver, the fee does not stand and no compensation is payable. The charge cannot be sustained under POL-NS-01 because limb (d) fails: the trip record terminates with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, which is the driver's own admission that he could not locate the rider and is not one of the three no-show reason codes POL-NS-01 recognises. The trip therefore falls to be decided under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06. The GPS trace shows the driver never entered the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for Blk 118. It records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes across the trip, and the closest the driver's track comes to the pin is 259.94 m. There is therefore no admissible arrival under POL-NS-02, and the in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 300 second minimum, so POL-NS-06 independently requires the full refund. The same result follows under POL-NS-03: the closest approach of 259.94 m is outside the 50 m arrival radius but inside the 400 m ceiling, and the driver did not arrive at the pickup point. The driver's argument that he waited 6.4 minutes does not save the fee. POL-NS-01(c) and POL-NS-06 measure the waiting period from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's arrival tap or the trip record's wait_time_min. The GPS shows no such fix. The driver's pin/carpark-side explanation is not supported by any venue_id comparison or chat statement, and the trip record has only 1 registered pickup point, so the POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill is unavailable. The rider's claim that the driver waited at block 128 also has no support in any artifact; the chat names only block 118. On driver compensation: POL-NS-07 compensation requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not. Under POL-NS-03(i), the rider named the correct block, Blk 118, in the chat and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, so the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. The chat log EV-CHAT-00205 is impaired at weight 0.8 with issue CONTENT_REDACTED, but the redaction removed only the unit number and the operative block identifier survives; the finding survives the discount. No escalation is warranted. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies. No POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral is entered because the arrival marker is not shown to be false under POL-NS-05's 300 m or speed test; the driver's closest approach was under 300 m and no speed is matched to the marker. Confidence is set at 0.95, with the main deciding facts carried by EV-GPS-00205 and EV-TRIP-00205 at weight 1.0.
